source: Original procedural synthesis, not extracted game audio

swing.layers: Short cloth/air swell; no impact transient or bass tail

swing_heavy.layers: Broader air swell, still quieter than contact

hit.layers: Dry leather transient + short body impulse + filtered friction

hit_alt.layers: Brighter palm/smack transient, shorter recovery than first punch

kick.layers: Lower body impulse and wider contact transient than a punch

heavy.layers: Immediate crack + textured low body impulse; shortened tonal tail

block.layers: Damped forearm knock and short cloth friction

block_heavy.layers: Heavier guard knock with additional low body layer

parry.layers: Immediate catch knock + delayed inharmonic release, not a UI chime

import: Short combat clips use uncompressed PCM with no trimming, normalization or looping; existing ultimate import is unchanged.
routing: Only actual hit/block/parry events select contact sounds; attack cues select air only. Stance and combo distinguish light contacts.
voicePolicy: 8 voices; free voice first, then oldest lowest priority. Air cannot replace a contact or parry. Deterministic small pitch variation; parry/ultimate pitch is fixed.
